statement: Demand tied to the TSMC campus and its suppliers is pulling forward home prices and rents in the North Phoenix corridor relative to the Phoenix metro.

confidence_reasoning.independence: Two support claims come from distinct origins (a local outlet and a developer press release).
confidence_reasoning.recency: Both claims were observed within the last 30 days.
confidence_reasoning.corroboration: The unit count is corroborated across the two origins; rent effects are not yet measured.
confidence_reasoning.mechanism: Employer-driven demand raising nearby prices is a standard mechanism with a plausible lag.
confidence_reasoning.base_rate: Corridor premiums around large employers usually appear within two years; the evidence is early.

causal_edges.mechanism: worker relocation adds local housing demand

implications.text: Corridor ZHVI may outgrow the metro ZHVI over the next 12 months.
Rents in 85085 may rise faster than the metro if supplier hiring continues.

open_questions.question: How many supplier jobs have actually been filled on site?

change_summary: Adds two cited claims on corridor approvals and raises confidence slightly; the previous seed version cited no claims.
